title: Glen Gray's nickname Spike and the Venuti connection
summary: Glen Gray was called Spike, and Venuti had played in the Goldkette band before Challis.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. And I remember a time when I had rejoined the Casa Loma, that it, it was then called the Glen Gray Orchestra, down in Miami.
I went down there with them and we were about to leave and the next guy following us in for his stint was Venuti, so Spike -- you know, he used to be with Goldkette band years ago.
When you say Spike, do you mean Glen Gray?
How did he get that nickname because I have seen it.
We have always called him Spike. His name is Glen Gray Knoblauch, and we always called him Spike.
I know I have seen that in the Encyclopedia but I have never seen him referred to as Spike in any of his -- publicly he was Glen Gray.
Anyway you said Spike had been with Goldkette.

No, Joe had been with the Goldkette band. Way back. We're talking about now way back before I got there. So Spike, I guess, maybe could have known him. There was another Spike out there that played violin, Spike Hamilton. He's George Hamilton's father.
I didn't know that, but I knew when
you said Spike then you meant Glen Gray, because I had seen it in the Encyclopedia.
